summary: Retested /gestor/dashboard light theme fix (iteration 13). Confirmed light theme is now applied to all Gestor tabs. Theme toggle works both directions and persists across reload.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme toggle uses View Transitions API and the DOM class flips only after the transition completes (~2-3s). Not a bug but tests should wait accordingly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 verified: /gestor/dashboard now renders in light theme by default (html class empty, body bg rgb(255,255,255), text rgb(34,48,28) dark green readable). KPI testids kpi-receita-hoje/kpi-receita-mes/kpi-pedidos-hoje/kpi-pedidos-mes all present and readable (R$ 0,00 in July 2026 is expected as noted). Tabs Gráfico/Gastos/Prazo/Cardápio/WhatsApp all render in light theme without unreadable text or broken layout. Runner and GYM Londres store switcher visible and functional on Dashboard. Theme toggle (data-testid=theme-toggle) toggles between light and dark cinematic; persists across reload (ganoh_theme + ganoh_theme_user set to 'dark' after user-initiated switch; back to 'light' on second toggle). Dark cinematic look preserved. Header logo visible in both themes. Nav pills show active state dark-green with white text as expected. No white-on-white or dark-on-dark issues detected.
